audio.transcript: Crispy rice paper chicken nuggets. It's fucking insane. And this only took me 20 minutes to make. Exquisite. Salt, black pepper, garlic and onion powder. And my secret ingredient is Spicex sweet sriracha blend. Now mix well with the chopsticks. For the rice paper, lightly wet it with some water, then lay it down flat quick because it will become malleable and soft. Place two dollops of filling in the middle, then roll it up into a sausage just like this. Then gently cut them up into bite-sized pieces with some scissors before spraying with some avocado oil. And now the only thing left to do is air fry it until they're golden brown and crispy with the settings to set on.
